maya_p: Quick heads up — candidate is confirmed for Friday 10:00am PT. Panel is Maya, Samir, Lina, Devon, Jordan. Can everyone still make it?

samir_patel: I can do 10:00 PT. I'll need the interview link + any shared context doc.

lina: I'm good. pls share room and rubric link.

devon: can join, but may be 5m late (back-to-back). is there a short 10m sync beforehand?

jordan: ok for 10:00. quick q on rubric: do we use the 1-5 scale or the new 0-3 one? want to be consistent in debriefs.

maya_p: Good q — people-ops asked to try 0-3 for this loop. The main differences: 0 = no evidence, 1 = limited, 2 = solid, 3 = exceptional. Also we should call out "collab" vs "depth" separately.

people-ops-bot: calendarbot added "Interview — Backend Engineer — Candidate A" to #people-ops (Fri, 10:00am PT).

samir_patel: thanks. can someone drop a tiny rubric snippet we can copy into notes?

maya_p: sure — copy/paste below: 
```
Scoring (0-3):
- Technical depth: 0/1/2/3
- Problem solving: 0/1/2/3
- Communication: 0/1/2/3
- Collaboration / Culture fit: 0/1/2/3
Recommend: No / Maybe / Yes
Hiring impact note (1 line):
```

lina: perfect. a couple of logistic asks: 1) remote panelists use the main Google Meet link (posted in the event) 2) please fill out the debrief within 24h, even if brief. we escalate missing debriefs to the hiring manager.

devon: noted. who owns kickoff (10:00 — quick 2m intro + take-home ask review)?

maya_p: i'll run kickoff and do the take-home check-in. if you're late just jump to the candidate question thread when you land.

jordan: small clarification: for "Recommend: Maybe" does that count as a blocker if two people say Maybe? how do we weight?

people-ops-bot: Reminder: debrief form link — https://redwood.example.com/debriefs/template (fillable).

lina: process-wise — hiring manager considers all scores. typical rule: 2+ "Yes" OR at least one "Yes" + no "No" with good notes => move forward. If mixed, HM will ask follow-ups. I'll paste this into the event notes.

samir_patel: thanks — also add a quick note in event: "please copy any code/run logs into the debrief if relevant". saves follow-up.

maya_p: added both links + the rubric snippet to event description. I'll ping again 30m before. 

jordan: one last thing — can people flag if they want to abstain from evaluating 'depth' because they didn't ask systems questions? just mark N/A in that field.

lina: yes mark N/A and add short reason. that's fine.

maya_p: awesome. see you all Friday. :thumbsup:
